capabilities: Open .html and .htm files in a visual editor
Drag, resize, select, duplicate, delete, and style page elements
Insert text, images, tables, layouts, canvas elements, and chart typography blocks
Save changes directly back to the opened vault file
Persist pasted base64 images to an assets folder
disambiguation: Edits .html and .htm source files in the vault, not Markdown notes.
extras: Save overwrites the opened file in place; the README advises keeping backups or version control. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian treats HTML files as plain files, so there is no way to open and visually edit a local HTML page inside the vault.
summary: Visual editor for .html and .htm vault files that lets you edit page elements directly and save changes back to the same file.
